description: Audit of bedrock-ffk (PR #79) found the same bug class fixed there exists one layer down: handle_version_too_new waitlists with opts[:reply_fn] even when nil; on notify, execute_fetch_request(context, nil, ...) runs the fetch synchronously and matches sync {:ok, value} against unguarded {:ok, pid} patterns (reading.ex:369 etc), crashing in Process.monitor. Guard those patterns or reject wait_ms without reply_fn. Also: {:waitlist_timing, key} process-dictionary entries (reading.ex:315) are written but never read/deleted — leak.
title: Fix waitlist crash class: nil reply_fn in Reading.execute_fetch_request
